info.name: rental-engine: internal FastAPI
info.description:
rental-engine's own FastAPI surface at 127.0.0.1:8000.

Auth: none (localhost-only service).
Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000

Current routes (as of Wave 1 / postman-mcp-install branch):
  GET /        - score-sorted HTML table, auto-refreshes every 60s
  GET /api/listings - JSON listing data
  POST /run    - trigger a scrape cycle (runs run.py in background)

Wave 2 routes (placeholder - Agent G):
  GET /viewer  - card-based listing viewer with sort/filter/paginate

Wave 3 routes (placeholder - Agents H and I):
  GET /sift
  POST /sift/submit
  GET /sift/{session_id}/propose
  POST /sift/{session_id}/apply

Update this collection in the same PR as the route implementation.

request.description:
Root route. Returns an HTML table of all active listings sorted by score DESC, price ASC. Auto-refreshes every 60s.

Response: 200 OK with HTML content. The table is colour-coded: green >= 80, amber 60-79, red < 60.

Note: This route is the current production surface. The Wave 2 /viewer route will supersede it as the primary UI.

request.description: JSON endpoint. Returns all active listings sorted by score DESC. Fields include: uid, portal, url, title, price, price_numeric, bedrooms, property_type, area, postcode, address, garden, balcony, tube_distance, cycle_canary_wharf, commute_canary_wharf, commute_whitechapel, commute_pass_40min, size_sqft, epc_rating, carpet_detected, carpet_confidence, carpet_in_bedroom, carpet_other_areas, score, property_metadata (JSON blob with score_breakdown), first_seen, last_scraped, is_active.

request.description:
Trigger a homehunt scrape cycle. Runs run.py in a background subprocess (fire-and-forget). Returns immediately with a status message.

Config: uses HOMEHUNT_CONFIG env var (default: london-search.yaml). The venv python at .venv/bin/python is hardcoded in api.py.

Note: this is a fire-and-forget endpoint. HTTP 200 means the subprocess was started, not that the scrape completed.

response.name: POST /run - 500 if subprocess fails to launch

request.description:
PLACEHOLDER - Endpoint added in Wave 2 (Agent G). Update this request once the route lands.

Expected: GET /viewer returns HTML with card list of listings. Sort options: score_desc, price_asc, sqft_desc, first_seen_desc. Filter options: source, region, beds, epc, max_price, min_sqft. Pagination: 20 cards per page via ?page=N.

Each card renders: score, price, bedrooms, area, EPC rating, commute times, carpet flags, garden/balcony, photo carousel, expandable EPC details panel (all 20 EPC fields when matched).

When EPC enrichment missed, card shows a hairline 'EPC unmatched' note instead of the panel.
